title: The Worm That Doubles When Struck
story: In the cinder tunnels under Fount Kiln, Grubblemaw the Doubling Slagworm starts 4 feet long — and every single strike makes it DOUBLE. A panicking guard has already struck it three times, and the tunnel is only so wide. Mr 6 sheathes his sword and pulls out his chalk instead.
question: Grubblemaw is 4 feet long now and doubles with each strike; the tunnel mouth is blocked once the worm reaches 96 feet. After the guard's next 4 strikes, how many feet LONGER than 96 feet will the worm be?
solution: Each strike doubles the length: 4 -> 8 -> 16 -> 32 -> 64 feet after 4 strikes.
The worm ends up 32 feet SHORT of blocking the tunnel, so the answer is -32 feet.
praise: Doubling step by step was the perfect strategy — the last move was subtracting 96 to compare, which flips the sign below zero.
hint: Double 4 one strike at a time (four times), then subtract 96 from what you get — the result can be negative.
victory: Mr 6 showed the guard the chalk numbers, the strikes stopped early, and Grubblemaw deflated into a grumpy 4-foot noodle that slithered off to find a quieter tunnel.
imagePrompt: A glowing orange slagworm swelling in a cinder-lit lava tunnel while a small numeral-six knight calmly holds up chalk calculations on the stone wall, warm ember glow and swirling ash.
